title: Warren County Farmers' Fair featuring the Balloon Festival
specs: Up to 20 hot air balloons launch each evening around 6:30 pm
Demolition derbies, truck and tractor pulls, livestock shows, and contests
Kids' Corral with crafts, contests, entertainment, and hands-on activities for children
Must call for passengers weighing more than 230 lbs or younger than 8 years old for balloon rides
Pets not allowed except service animals or show animals
Single riders placed with others in basket; basket capacity 2-4 people based on weight

blurb: Guests attend a multi-day county fair with livestock shows, contests, arts and crafts, demolition derbies, truck and tractor pulls, and a hot air balloon festival. The balloon festival includes evening balloon launches and tethered rides. The fair also offers amusement rides, games, food concessions, and a Kids' Corral with activities and entertainment for children.
